import sys

MOD = 998244353

def fastpow(n, ti):
    return pow(n, ti, MOD)

def modInv(x):
    return pow(x, MOD - 2, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data)
    if l == r:
        print(1)
        return

    odds = ((r + 1) // 2) - (l // 2)
    evens = (r // 2) - ((l - 1) // 2)

    if (n * m) % 2 == 1:
        ans = fastpow(odds + evens, n * m)
    else:
        ans = (fastpow(odds + evens, n * m) + fastpow(odds - evens, n * m)) % MOD
        ans = (ans * modInv(2)) % MOD

    print(ans)
    sys.stdout.flush()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
